name: hazel_weir_high_velocity_acreage_expansion_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Execution Graph featuring 22-26 plot synchronized land expansion, vacant-plot gated Town Shop arbitrage, dynamic-floor capital velocity liquidations, immediate post-harvest shed drop-offs, Day 22-26 late Carrot turnover backfills, and Step 680 terminal market clearance.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Audits net available cash, uncultivated vacant plots, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, carried backpack capacity, simulation step count, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Guarantees midnight payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to eliminate the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Strictly conditions seed procurement on uncultivated vacant plot availability (uncultivated_vacant_plots > 0) and growth feasibility (day + crop_growth_days <= 28; no slow crops after Day 17), fulfilling orders primarily from existing inventory to protect recurring Strawberry acreage.

nodes.name: Dynamic Capital Velocity & Terminal Liquidation
nodes.description: Maintains rapid daylight capital velocity via early micro-batch liquidations (>=2 surplus on Days 1-5; >=6 surplus or shed_used >= 35 on Days 6-28), dynamic mid-game price floors (0.85x base, flexing to 0.75x base if shed fullness >= 50% or Oracle glut risk >= 0.45), and terminal farm-wide liquidation clearance from Step 680 down to 0.65x base.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Monitors 96-step TTM forecast to front-run opponent dump waves on sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) when glut risk >= 0.48 and current price >= 0.75x base, protecting cash flow before open market crashes.

nodes.name: Acreage Scaling & Reinvestment Strategy
nodes.description: Synchronizes workforce and land expansion across three cash-funded waves to 22-26 plots with 10-11 hands (Wave 1: 8-10 plots by Day 5 with 3-4 hands; Wave 2: 16-18 plots by Day 9-10 with 6-8 hands; Wave 3: 22-26 plots by Day 14-16 with 10-11 hands). Transitions all non-shop acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries through Day 22, backfilling vacant plots with 3-day Carrots on Days 22-26.

nodes.name: Post-Harvest Velocity & Farm Execution
nodes.description: Dispatches hands with immediate post-harvest shed drop-offs to continuously supply daylight liquidation and free backpack space for well water. Sequences routine: 1) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring crops, 2) Cluster Harvest ripe plots, 3) Immediate Shed Drop-Off when full or cluster finishes, 4) Water dry plots, 5) Pre-fertilize and Plant, 6) Feed livestock, 7) Weed/Till.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases immediately; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of uncontracted non-feed inventory at hour >= 20 down to 0.70x base to guarantee midnight payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (uncultivated_vacant_plots > 0 and net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 25)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Deliver matching shed inventory to town shops immediately for 2.0x-3.5x premium up to step 710. Procure and plant shop seeds strictly when uncultivated_vacant_plots > 0, day + crop_growth_days <= 28, and (crop != 'pumpkin' and crop != 'tomato' or day <= 17). Fulfill orders from existing inventory whenever plots are already seeded with recurring Strawberries.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase shop seeds or till under productive hyper-fertilized Strawberry plots when uncultivated_vacant_plots == 0. Never purchase slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) after Day 17 or if day + crop_growth_days > 28. Never hoard inventory speculatively for unrevealed contracts.

attributes.condition: (day <= 5 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 2) or (day > 5 and (uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 6 or shed_used >= 35)) or step >= 680
attributes.guidance: Micro-batch liquidate early Carrot surplus (>=2 units) on Days 1-5 at >= 0.85x base to rapidly fund initial hands and plots. Mid-game (Days 6-28), batch liquidate surplus at >= 0.85x base price; if shed fullness >= 50% or oracle_glut_risk >= 0.45, dynamically relax liquidation floor to 0.75x base to prevent capital lockup. From Step 680 (Day 28.3) onward, initiate terminal clearance of all uncontracted shed and carried inventory, progressively stepping down the price floor to 0.65x base to guarantee 100% liquidation before market liquidity closes.
attributes.pitfalls: Never hold uncontracted inventory at rigid >=0.88x floors while shed overflows or opponent dumping collapses spot prices; dynamically lower floor to 0.75x. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate inventory allocated to active town shop contracts.

attributes.guidance: Read 96-step TTM forecast to front-run opponent dump waves on vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) when glut risk >= 0.48 and current price >= 0.75 * base_price before market prices crash further.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on weak glut signals (risk < 0.48); do not dump below 0.75x base price unless terminal clearance (step >= 680) is active; never front-run inventory reserved for active town shop orders.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 0.75 + 60.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 11 or total_plots < 26 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Synchronize workforce and acreage expansion across three distinct waves: 1) Wave 1 (Days 1-5): Scale to 8-10 contiguous plots with 3-4 hands funded by early Carrots; 2) Wave 2 (Days 6-10): Scale to 16-18 contiguous plots with 6-8 hands, transitioning acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries; 3) Wave 3 (Days 11-16): Scale to 22-26 contiguous plots with 10-11 hands funded by the first Strawberry harvest flushes, establishing a balanced ~2.2 plots/hand ratio. Cap workforce at 11 hands and land at 26 plots max. Strictly pair Strawberry seeds 1:1 with fertilizer and cut off Strawberry procurement on Day 22. Between Days 22-26, backfill any vacant plots with 3-day Carrots to extract 1-2 additional high-margin turnover cycles.
attributes.pitfalls: Never cap acreage at 16 plots when 11 hands are active, which wastes payroll overhead. Never buy Strawberry seeds or fertilizer after Day 22; do not leave vacant plots unplanted between Days 22-26 (backfill with Carrots instead). Never expand land during evening hours (hour >= 18) unless net cash exceeds 1.35x midnight payroll + plot cost.

attributes.guidance: Execute routine farm operations prioritizing immediate shed drop-offs to feed daytime liquidation and clear worker backpacks for watering: 1) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring Strawberry plots if carrying water and plot is dry, 2) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots up to inventory capacity, 3) Immediate Shed Drop-Off whenever carried_items >= capacity or a harvest cluster completes, freeing hands to draw well water and triggering daytime capital velocity, 4) Water dry cultivated plots to prevent regrowth freezes, 5) Pre-fertilize and Plant vacant plots (Strawberries Days 5-22, 3-day Carrots Days 1-4 and backfill Days 22-26), 6) Feed livestock (Wheat reserve = n_animals * 3), 7) Weed/Till. Guarantee all carried goods are deposited at the shed by Step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dispatch hands with full backpacks to water dry plots before depositing crops at the shed, as full inventory blocks drawing water and starves midday capital velocity. Never leave harvested Strawberry plots unwatered. Never allow hands to idle while ripe crops or dry plots exist.
